dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing from the widest mid-body point to an acute point at the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Minor asymmetrical deviation on the right lateral margin, showing a slight convexity followed by a shallow concavity relative to the more uniform left margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light greyish-white tone with subtle blue-hue undertones; categorized as a late-stage sub-adult or mature light-grey profile.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low spatial frequency; diffuse, non-clustered grey shading observed primarily on the anterior cranial region and the posterior right flank.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse; high-gradient blending between the slightly darker cephalic region and the lighter dorsal trunk.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: Presence of a single, high-contrast dark circular aperture at the anterior dorsal midline (blowhole); no other distinct point-contrast lesions or marks visible.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Subtle longitudinal ridge or indentation visible along the central axis in the posterior third of the visible dorsal plane.
